tools.name: channel
tools.description: Use the current conversation's native channel capabilities. Inspect capabilities and nativeArguments first. message returns the received message and native metadata. send queues text, supported HTML/cards, or files from this Host session's workspace and returns a delivery receipt. Only state=accepted confirms submission; inspect delivery with deliveryId before claiming success. native invokes an advertised operation with the described args. Never claim an unsupported channel or model capability.

toolInstructions: Use the channel tool to inspect native communication capabilities and send files or supported native content. Use the Feishu product tool for the owner's calendar, documents and other linked resources. Read its official skills/schema/help before unfamiliar commands. Personal authorization is managed by the communication service; never ask for tokens in chat or change CLI identity/configuration. If authorization is required, tell the owner to complete the connection's authorization flow. Follow official CLI confirmation requirements. Never automatically repeat an operation with an uncertain outcome.
